abilities.name: Limitless
abilities.description: An inherited technique that gives Gojo precise control over space.

abilities.name: Six Eyes
abilities.description: An innate trait that grants extraordinary perception and highly efficient cursed energy control.

abilities.name: Infinity
abilities.description: The neutral form of Limitless that slows approaching objects so they cannot reach Gojo.

abilities.name: Blue
abilities.description: A spatial attraction technique that pulls matter toward a chosen point.

abilities.name: Red
abilities.description: A reversal of Limitless that creates a powerful repulsive force.

abilities.name: Hollow Purple
abilities.description: A destructive technique formed by combining Blue and Red.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.description: Allows Gojo to heal himself and restore his cursed technique.

abilities.name: Simple Domain
abilities.description: An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a domain's sure-hit effect.

abilities.name: Falling Blossom Emotion
abilities.description: An anti-domain art that counterattacks a domain's sure-hit effect.

domain.name: Unlimited Void
abilities: Floods targets with boundless information and stimuli.
Restrains the thoughts and actions of victims trapped inside.
Allows Gojo to precisely control the domain's duration and barrier conditions.
